articles.title: Country in a Box
articles.subtitle: A registry, exchange and court can share records while remaining independent.
articles.description: Connected records help a jurisdiction establish its registry, exchange and court while preserving each institution's independence.

figures.alt: Registry: keeps ownership and authority records current. Exchange: brings buyers and sellers together. Court: deals with contested rights and conduct. The software and procedures that connect them.

figures.after: The history must retain the original entry
figures.alt: Consent before a transfer → the recorded consent names a different transaction → the court orders the transfer to pause → permit the transfer or require a correction. The original entry, the dispute and the act that changed the position.

figures.after: For a business run by AI agents
figures.alt: Merchant banks were built for shops with a front door → Stripe rebuilt the merchant bank → online commerce at scale followed. The registrar · licence office · tax office · bank: need to receive instructions around the clock.

figures.after: Recourse's design covers case administration
figures.alt: Mass: runs companies, institutions, and deployments; makes the compliance call before each action runs. Moxie: prices and clears claims; in testnet. Recourse: runs dispute resolution and carries outcomes into execution; at the research and design stage.

figures.after: The bank's executed act and the beneficiary's receipt are separate events.
figures.alt: A direction to pay → the bank’s executed act → the beneficiary’s receipt. What was done, what arrived and which obligations remain.

figures.after: A registry connected to an exchange supplies a new court
figures.alt: Registry + exchange → court: records of the rights being traded and the transactions that give rise to disputes. Registry + court → exchange: access to records of rights and a procedure for resolving challenges to them. Exchange + court → registry: histories of transactions, obligations and decisions.

articles.title: Sovereigns need AI courts for autonomous commerce
articles.subtitle: AI can prepare a case, while people remain responsible for deciding it and giving the decision lawful effect.
articles.description: Autonomous commerce needs a fair hearing, accountable institutions and a lawful route from contested conduct to remedy.

figures.alt: A company’s AI agent withholds payment; orders a repair → the contractor’s system records completion and requests payment → another system schedules work on the assumption that the repair is complete. The equipment still fails.

figures.after: I would begin with AI preparing and analysing cases
figures.alt: AI preparing and analysing cases → judges and arbitrators responsible for deciding them.

figures.after: An authorized restriction can stop a specified action while the case proceeds
figures.alt: An authorized restriction can stop a specified action while the case proceeds: scope · duration · route to review. People need effective notice, access to the material used against them, an opportunity to challenge it.

figures.after: Mass lets AI agents automate companies, trade, commerce and markets
figures.alt: Each company’s own AI agent, on any AI model it chooses → drives the company’s operations from formation to closure. Mass makes the compliance call before each action runs.

figures.after: A summary should distinguish a party's statement
figures.alt: A party’s statement · a recorded event · the system’s inference: each assertion linked to its source. Missing evidence stays visible as a gap.

figures.after: Issuing an award, permitting execution
figures.alt: Issuing an award → permitting execution → sending an instruction → receiving money. Each has its own responsible actor and evidence.

figures.after: The case administrator would receive no share
figures.alt: Users would pay for case services under published terms. The network would earn its disclosed service fees. Practitioners would charge for their expertise and time. The case administrator would receive no share of counsel’s fees, referral payment or origination fee.

figures.after: An hourly rate can stay the same whichever party wins
figures.alt: Before cases are assigned: total remuneration, payment dates, service capacity, term. Cannot increase that entitlement: extra hours · workload · hearings · appeals · case counts · assignments · outcomes.

articles.title: People need a lawful way to challenge digital transfers
articles.subtitle: A transfer can follow network rules while ownership remains disputed, and a remedy needs authority that people can challenge.
articles.description: People disputing digital transfers need a fair hearing, a lawful remedy and a way to challenge the institutions exercising authority.

figures.alt: Someone steals the secret key → a transfer that satisfies the network’s rules → the transfer enters a blockchain. The wallet owner can see where the assets went and disputes the authority to move them.

figures.after: The International Institute for the Unification of Private Law distinguishes
figures.alt: Factual control · distinguishes · a valid transfer of rights.

figures.after: An allegation must remain distinguishable from a verified event
figures.alt: The case file should retain: the transaction records · the basis for interpreting them · the owner’s account of the compromise. An allegation must remain distinguishable from a verified event.

figures.after: requires the order to reach someone able and entitled to act
figures.alt: The order → execution → someone able and entitled to act.

figures.after: The record must therefore distinguish a decision, an instruction, and an observed result.
figures.alt: A decision → an instruction → an observed result.

figures.after: Decentralized autonomy means participants can
figures.alt: Decentralized autonomy means participants can: verify instructions through systems they control · retain evidence outside the issuing institution · reject requests that exceed agreed authority.

figures.after: Each instruction should identify the issuing institution
figures.alt: Each instruction should identify: the issuing institution · the parties and assets concerned · the permitted action · when it can take effect.

figures.after: A transfer can appear on one blockchain
figures.alt: A transfer can appear on one blockchain · its supporting agreement elsewhere · the relevant assets with a custodian → bring those records together.

figures.after: Each company's own AI agent, on any AI model it chooses
figures.alt: Each company’s own AI agent, on any AI model it chooses → drives the company’s operations from formation to closure. Mass makes the compliance call before each action runs.

figures.after: Both could use the same service.
figures.alt: A financial free zone · a person whose wallet was hacked. Both could use the same service.
